'''C-RG9''' was a [[Battle droid/Legends|battle droid]] used by the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] during the [[Galactic War]]. During the [[Battle of Ilum]] in [[3640 BBY]] it was used to guard the war room of [[Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]], who planned a retaliation strike against [[Darth Malgus]]' [[New Empire]].<ref name="SWTOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
C-RG9 appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as an NPC on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ilum/Legends|Ilum]], who begins the quest for the "False Emperor" flashpoint.
